answer: An agent marketplace selling comet forecasts, mesa maps and inlet surveys weights dispute votes by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, rather than by account count. Splitting 1,000 tokens among a thousand fake agents gives the attacker exactly the same voting weight as one agent staking 1,000. To gain control, the attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens than honest voters, tying up capital for the full lock period.
